facts.fact: The World Bank says nearly 1.17 million people were registered and issued birth certificates between 1 August 2022 and 28 February 2023 using an electronic CRVS (eCRVS) system that replaced the paper process.
The Registrar General CRVS says an eCRVS system was deployed in August 2022 and that over 1.4 million people were registered and issued a birth certificate as of June 2026.

facts.fact: The Registrar General's slides report 1,238,662 births in the eCRVS digital cumulative registration from August 2022 to March 2025, shown for every local government area, equal to 53% of a 2.4m population.
